## What's new

MENU > Controls on the home screen is now Main Menu Controls: moving, the
shelf, the menus, Muse and the buttons that work anywhere, and nothing about
games. A game's buttons are on its console's own Controls - GB Controls,
Genesis Controls - from the in-game menu (where Buttons was) and the
console's menu: what each of the Brick's buttons does there now, with your
Button Mapping and turbo, then MENU, fast forward, rewind when it is on, and
power. Button Mapping is a submenu at the top of it, titled for its console
too.

Screens with pages say where you are at the bottom - the page's name and
"2 of 5" - with an arrow toward each side there is another page, none past
the first or last; left and right stop at the ends instead of wrapping.

---

ChaOS 0.9.1 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.9.1-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.9.1-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
